verdict.rationale: Digits documents a public Connect API that gives programmatic read and write access to its ledger. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 authorization-code auth with granular scopes, an OpenAPI 3.0 spec with codegen, route-based versioning, a free resettable developer sandbox, and a reference spanning statements, chart of accounts, transaction sync and the bills workflow. Probes confirm the developer docs and llms.txt are live, but the OpenAPI candidate paths returned 404; the documented /openapi path was not probed, so this does not contradict the docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live API calls, a verified fetch of the OpenAPI spec at its documented URL

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Digits replaces all of that with a single, intelligent API.
The Digits Connect API provides a complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification that describes all available endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and authentication requirements.
The Digits Connect API uses OAuth 2.0 with the authorization code grant type for secure authentication.
The Digits Connect API uses route-based versioning with the version number as a URL path prefix.
Each developer has access to their own resettable demo instance
Idempotence and deduplication is handled via the external_id field
